text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is a yearly grand event where Umamusume of the classic and senior years compete for the time-honored Autumn Shield.
This race holds particularly special meaning for each of the racers standing in the paddock at this moment.
King Halo, Special Week, or Seiun Sky.
Which of these Golden Generation racers will lay claim to both center stage and the Autumn Shield?
